sources.name: OPRA
sources.scope: Official OPRA runtime/database feeds used by the existing app
sources.cursor_strategy: source fingerprint and upstream revision metadata
sources.license_notes: The Android runtime checks the OPRA database feed directly on the app's approximately-daily refresh path and keeps its own last-known-good cache. Repository source-health timestamps therefore do not claim to represent every end-user OPRA refresh.

sources.name: AutoEq
sources.scope: Full structured ParametricEQ result corpus with upstream measurement-source and rig/context provenance
sources.cursor_strategy: repository commit plus per-file structured content hash
sources.license_notes: AutoEq software is MIT licensed, while measurements originate from multiple third-party sources. EQ Library republishes only structured equalizer coefficients generated by AutoEq, retains the upstream measurement source and rig/context as provenance, and does not redistribute raw third-party measurement data or treat the software license as blanket permission for that measurement data.

sources.name: MrChillStorm Headphone Target
sources.scope: Explicitly MIT-licensed author repository with structured headphone/IEM PEQ examples derived from the author's ISO 226:2023 target framework
sources.cursor_strategy: qualified manifest plus GitHub file blob SHA and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: Repository LICENSE is MIT (copyright 2026 MrChillStorm). Only exact profiles enumerated in config/qualified_github_sources.json are publication-eligible. EQ Library presents these as creator/community tunings and does not endorse source claims about target superiority or scientific validity.

sources.name: Fairbuds by Juraj Fiala
sources.scope: Exact hand-authored Fairphone Fairbuds PEQ records from jurf/fairbuds; third-party-measurement-derived AutoEq outputs in the same repository are excluded
sources.cursor_strategy: qualified manifest plus GitHub file blob SHA and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: The public jurf/fairbuds repository is identified by GitHub as MIT licensed. Publication is restricted to explicitly qualified files with repository history supporting author-origin. presets/main-ish.txt was refined by repository author Juraj Fiala by hand (commit 66cf13ae87429315e4c1d709d5c327c39e074e85). Presets generated from RTINGS, SoundGuys, DHRME or other third-party measurement inputs are not qualified by this source entry.

sources.name: oratory1990
sources.scope: Direct creator provenance for author-created EQ presets; structured filter values continue to arrive through separately qualified sources such as OPRA unless redistribution permission is explicit
sources.cursor_strategy: creator update timestamp/source URL plus acoustic fingerprint of the qualified structured carrier
sources.license_notes: Direct creator pages/PDFs are used for attribution and manual update review only. OPRA-carried structured presets may be enriched with direct creator provenance without duplicating the tuning. AutoEq results derived from oratory1990 measurements remain AutoEq-created results, not oratory-authored presets. Anonymous Reddit update polling is not scheduled while that public path returns HTTP 403 Blocked.

sources.name: Squiglink-compatible sources
sources.scope: Public Squiglink/CrinGraph-compatible records and exact public PEQ where a source exposes it
sources.license_notes: Exact public source-authored PEQ coefficients may flow through the normal Unverified community process with creator/source attribution. Squiglink phone-book and measurement records are measurements, not PEQ presets: EQ Library never invents filters from a curve or assumes Q/filter types that the source did not provide. Measurement-only records therefore remain non-publishable unless the source also exposes exact structured PEQ.

sources.name: Reddit audio communities
sources.scope: Public structured PEQ posts and original preset links
sources.cursor_strategy: post/comment IDs, timestamps, and deterministic scan fingerprints
sources.license_notes: Public community EQ coefficients are publication-eligible. EQ Library normalizes numeric PEQ data, retains the Reddit author and original permalink, and does not copy unrelated post prose. Private, deleted, or restricted content is not accessed. As of 2026-09-06, GitHub-hosted unauthenticated Reddit JSON listing/search requests returned HTTP 403 Blocked across all configured r/headphones and r/oratory1990 probes. Live scanning is paused until a compliant public access path is validated; existing archived and curated Reddit EQs remain preserved.

sources.name: Head-Fi
sources.scope: Public headphone/model EQ discussions containing structured PEQ settings
sources.license_notes: Publicly posted community EQ coefficients are publication-eligible. Preserve the author, forum name, original post URL, exact filter structure, and any distinction between source-authored values and EQ Library-generated conversions or safety headroom. The current publication lane is curated/manual; no autonomous live-site scanner is claimed until a robust public adapter is validated.

sources.name: Audio Science Review
sources.scope: Public headphone/IEM threads with structured PEQ settings and traceable mirrors of expert presets
sources.license_notes: Publicly posted community EQ coefficients are publication-eligible with author and original thread/post provenance retained. When an ASR post is a mirror of an already-canonical expert preset, it is retained as secondary provenance instead of creating a duplicate EQ. The current publication lane is curated/manual; no autonomous live-site scanner is claimed until a robust public adapter is validated.

sources.name: The HEADPHONE Community / Headphones.com
sources.scope: Public creator/community EQ posts, measurements, and tuning discussions hosted at forum.headphones.com
sources.cursor_strategy: topic/post IDs, timestamps, and source content hashes
sources.license_notes: Publicly posted community EQ coefficients are publication-eligible. This is the single canonical registry identity for forum.headphones.com; preserve creator/username, topic/post URL, exact source filter structure, and label any EQ Library-derived conversion separately from the source-authored preset.

sources.name: HiFiGuides Forums
sources.scope: Public headphone and IEM discussion threads containing original structured PEQ settings
sources.cursor_strategy: topic/post IDs, timestamps, and source content hashes
sources.license_notes: Public numeric EQ coefficients are publication-eligible for this project when creator/username and original forum URL are preserved. EQ Library stores the structured coefficients and minimal tuning context, not unrelated forum prose, and does not access private or restricted content.

sources.name: Public GitHub repositories and Gists
sources.scope: Public structured headphone-specific and General EQ community presets discovered in GitHub repositories and Gists
sources.cursor_strategy: discovery queue plus immutable source blob SHA and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: Public source-authored numeric EQ coefficients are handled through the same Unverified community policy as public forum EQs: preserve repository owner/creator and commit-specific source URL, parse exact values only, deduplicate mirrors by acoustic fingerprint, and quarantine ambiguous identity or malformed/unsupported data without blocking unrelated candidates. Public source code visibility alone never permits inventing missing filter parameters.

sources.name: Topping Community
sources.scope: Public official and fan-made tuning resources exposed through Topping's community tooling
sources.license_notes: Exact public community-posted EQ coefficients may publish as Unverified with source URL and author attribution through the normal community path. Screenshots, curve-only views, and device UI state without exact frequency/gain/Q/filter-type data are not converted into invented filters. Device-format conversions must be labeled separately from the original source tuning.

sources.name: ParaEQ built-in General EQ presets
sources.scope: MIT-licensed source-authored device-independent tonal, utility, and genre presets from wabsto1/ParaEQ
sources.cursor_strategy: pinned repository commit plus source-record acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: ParaEQ is MIT licensed (copyright 2026 wabsto1). EQ Library publishes only the exact built-in preset filter parameters explicitly represented in Sources/Models.swift at pinned commit 51d6f6d29aef607a3a2e26b829549f9c8d7fec6e, retains creator/source provenance, keeps missing source preamp null, and stores any EQ Library-generated safety headroom separately.

sources.name: MilcioSSQ EQ built-in General presets
sources.scope: MIT-licensed source-authored five-band General EQ presets from MilcioSSQ/eq, excluding Flat and ambiguous labels that do not safely establish Sound/Genre/Utility intent
sources.cursor_strategy: pinned source file blob SHA plus source-record acoustic fingerprint; upstream changes are review-gated before replacing the qualified manifest
sources.license_notes: MilcioSSQ/eq is MIT licensed (copyright 2026 MilcioSSQ). EQ Library publishes exact source-authored gains at the source's declared 60/250/1000/4000/16000 Hz low-shelf/peaking/peaking/peaking/high-shelf bands with source-declared Q=1, keeps missing preamp null, and stores generated safety headroom separately. The qualified snapshot is pinned to commit 5e294b506ea13be1489310fcd67f397739d38eb0. Genre classification is used only for clearly source-named genre/style labels; ambiguous labels such as Classic and Piano are not included.
